report.summary: Patient P-D002 (46, Medicaid via Lakeshore Community Health Plan with a transportation benefit) screened positive for a transportation need (screener: transportation = no). Most recent endocrinology appointments were a no-show and a cancellation; the latest primary-care visit was kept. Home tract 17031300900 has 53 transit stops within 800 m and early-morning service, but 19.6% of adults report lacking transportation, so community options remain useful. Facility-level transit feasibility could not be checked because no facility location is on file for the scheduled appointment.

options.name: Medicaid Ride Line (plan transportation benefit)
options.how_to_access: Call the phone number on the Lakeshore Community Health Plan Medicaid card at least 2 business days before the appointment to book a non-emergency medical ride; verify eligibility through the plan.

options.name: RideWell Medical Transport
options.how_to_access: Walk-ins welcome; serves the west side; open Tuesday and Thursday 10 AM–1 PM. Eligibility confirmation was not completed to avoid unnecessary sharing of identifiers.

options.name: Paratransit Info Desk (ADA paratransit certification)
options.how_to_access: Apply by phone for ADA paratransit certification; allow up to 21 days for a decision; appropriate if a disability limits fixed-route transit use.

options.name: Senior Shuttle West
options.how_to_access: Free rides for adults 60+ to medical appointments, weekdays 7 AM–5 PM. Patient is 46, so not age-eligible; listed for completeness only.
